enchantments.tooltip: Vulkoor's Bite: Vulkoor calls to you, and death answers. Attacks and offensive spells have a chance to deal 1d3 Negative levels.
Dark Restoration Lore +23: Passive: Your Negative, Poison and Positive spells gain a 23% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Dark Restoration +157: Passive: +157 Equipment bonus to Negative, Poison and Positive Spell Power.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +59 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Negative Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming negative energy healing by +59 (Profane bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Taint of Evil: Good aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
